Data sources / NESO Data Portal

Constraint costs and volumes by reason

neso_data_portal/constraint_breakdown

NESO's daily cost in pounds and volume in MWh of its actions on the transmission network, split into four reasons.

Vendor
NESO Data Portal, package Constraint Breakdown Costs and Volume
Cadence
Daily values; NESO's catalogue lists the update frequency as weekly
Grain
One row per date and capture; read the _latest view for one per date
Key
resource_id, date, published_at
History
Yearly April-to-March files from 2017-18, as NESO's catalogue lists them

What it is

NESO's daily account of why it acted on the transmission network: a cost in £ and a volume in MWh for each of four reasons, reducing the largest loss, increasing system inertia, voltage and thermal constraints. One file per April-to-March year. NESO says actions can be retagged after the event and the data refreshed, so past dates can change.

How it’s used

  • Daily thermal and voltage constraint cost as inputs to balancing-cost models.
  • Inertia and largest-loss spend: the cost of limiting the rate of change of frequency.
  • Revision studies: compare captures of a yearly file as NESO restates dates.

bronze, the response as fetched

The raw feed

From NESO's CKAN portal: one package_show, then each yearly file downloaded whole unless its last_modified is unchanged. Dates select nothing; silver keeps every capture.

GET https://api.neso.energy/api/3/action/package_show    ?id=constraint-breakdown
GET https://api.neso.energy/dataset/fb56b46e-cef3-4eb8-9294-0ca19769b7eb/resource/4136a8e2-07c5-4784-8096-28999447a16e/download/constraint-breakdown-2026-2027.csv
# whole files; window must end recentlygridflow ingest neso_data_portal constraint_breakdown --last 24h# the capture's date to silvergridflow transform neso_data_portal constraint_breakdown --last 24h

Identifies a row

date
NESO's date of the costs and volumes; NESO does not state the day boundary
published_at
NESO's last-modified time for the whole file, read as UTC; one per capture
resource_id
NESO's id for the April-to-March file; with date, the code's entity key

Other columns

thermal_constraints_cost_gbp
Thermal constraints, £: actions on flows above circuit capacity between regions (NESO)
thermal_constraints_volume_mwh
Thermal constraints volume, MWh; signed, and NESO does not define the sign
voltage_constraints_cost_gbp
Voltage constraints, £: actions for reactive-power balance and regional voltage (NESO)
voltage_constraints_volume_mwh
Voltage constraints volume, MWh; signed, and NESO does not define the sign
increasing_system_inertia_cost_gbp
Increasing system inertia, £: actions adding synchronous generation (NESO)
increasing_system_inertia_volume_mwh
Increasing system inertia volume, MWh
reducing_largest_loss_cost_gbp
Reducing largest loss, £: cutting the largest credible loss (NESO); zero in these rows
reducing_largest_loss_volume_mwh
Reducing largest loss volume, MWh; NESO's own dictionary example is negative
timestamp_utc
Start of settlement period 1 of date, GB local midnight, as UTC; gridflow's anchor
bronze_capture_id
The bronze file the row was read from; one per capture
capture_written_at
When gridflow wrote the capture to bronze, UTC

gold, served to the notebook

Query it from a notebook

Returns a pandas DataFrame from the DuckDB view silver_neso_data_portal_constraint_breakdown_latest, the newest complete capture of each yearly file, filtered on date with both ends included. Lineage columns are dropped; times print in local time.

Needs gridflow and gridflow-models installed, with one capture of every yearly file ingested.
